# Test recordings

The `voice-*.wav` files are short excerpts of LibriSpeech (dev-clean) recordings, used by the
voice profile tests:

- `voice-a-*`: speaker 84, utterances 84-121123-0000 to 0007
- `voice-b-*`: speaker 174, utterances 174-168635-0000 to 0006
- `voice-ab-talk.wav`: the two talk excerpts back to back

LibriSpeech ASR corpus, V. Panayotov, G. Chen, D. Povey and S. Khudanpur, ICASSP 2015.
https://www.openslr.org/12/ Licensed under CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The excerpts were converted to 16 kHz mono and joined with short silences.
